newsitem.title: JAPAN: S.Arabia cuts April Asia Super Light crude - traders.
newsitem.headline: S.Arabia cuts April Asia Super Light crude - traders.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has cut its April-lifting price formula for Arab Super Light crude to Asian customers by 50 cents a barrel, traders said on Wednesday.
This brings the April contract price for Arab Super Light crude to $2.95 a barrel above the Oman/Dubai average, a cut from the Oman/Dubai average plus $3.45 for March, traders said.
Saudi Arabia also said it would cut its April-lifting price formula for Berri Extra Light crude to Asian customers by 25 cents a barrel, but will keep formulas for other crudes unchanged.
This brings the April contract price for Berri Extra Light crude to $1.70 a barrel above the Oman/Dubai average, from the Oman/Dubai average plus $1.95 for March, traders said.

Contract prices for other crudes were unchanged with Arab Light at the Oman/Dubai average plus 60 cents, Arab Medium at the Oman/Dubai average minus 40 cents and Arab Heavy at a discount of $1.25 to the Oman/Dubai average, traders said.
